content:
Events emitted by DrorPay to your socket connection:

- payment-room-joined: Confirmation your room join succeeded.
  Payload: { platform_order_id }

- payment-status-update: Any status change.
  Payload: { platform_transaction_id, status, platform_order_id, amount, message, timestamp }

- payment-completed: Payment succeeded.
  Payload adds: fee_paid, platform_charges, transaction_id, reference_id

- payment-failed: Payment failed.
  Payload adds: error message

- payment-cancelled: Payment cancelled.
  Payload: { platform_transaction_id, status: 'cancelled', platform_order_id, amount, message, timestamp }

- join-payment-error: Room join failed.
  Payload: { message }

To leave a room: socket.emit('leave-payment-room', { platform_order_id: 'order-123' })
